patch_description: This keeps the recommended 0.85/0.15 direct-link calibration, but replaces the dense two-hop construction with a sparse relay-selection scheme. For each OD pair, it rewards only a few candidate two-hop routes, chosen using both demand and the usefulness of their constituent links. Relay pressure discounts routes through nodes with high incident traffic. The smaller interaction graph is intended to make QAOA partitions more focused while retaining plausible alternatives for routing traffic indirectly.
